capsule_first.reason: The named runtime-mechanics questions were answered by pristine ASM, authored DAT records, constructor metadata, and already-banked passive-prop/pass-3 A/B evidence. Exact presentation timing is not required for bounded partial closure.

kind_0x31.correction: Kind 0x31 is not telescope activation and the helper at 0x80057620 is not a kind-0x30/0x31 helper. The branch at 0x80053CA8 bypasses that common five-object pickup burst for exactly kinds 0x30 and 0x31.
kind_0x31.authored_domain: 39 records in eight of 21 DATs: seven five-record groups and one four-record group in LEVEL10/LEVEL.DAT. Every record starts Y=-600, status=0, restY=0.
kind_0x31.status_semantic: Entry +0x0D is a per-frame visibility/eligibility result, not persisted authored state. pickup_projector clears it at 0x80025544 and sets it at 0x800255BC after distance/sentinel visibility gates; source3f_dispatch consumes status==1.
kind_0x31.construct_gate: At 0x800539A0..0x80053A18: kind==0x31, restY-currentY>=113, squared proximity<=0x3D08F, and phase byte 0x800910A2==0. The phase byte alternates 0/1 at 0x800551B4 and is cleared during scene reset at 0x8005B918.
kind_0x31.construct_effect: contact_alloc(X<<5, (Y-160)<<5, Z<<5, ctor=83+ordinal, metadata_A_row=21). Authored ordinals therefore select ctor rows 84..88 for a five-record group.
kind_0x31.metadata_rows_84_88: All five rows use action_id=1, active_type=20, init=-8, component/radius values 90/90, selector=2, flags=0x20. Their final three bytes are respectively 80/00/00, 00/80/00, 00/40/80, 80/80/00, 00/00/80. Interpreting these triplets as five color variants is strong render-shaped inference; exact pixels were not captured.
kind_0x31.contact_action: At exact currentY==restY-112, 0x800545A0..0x800545C0 changes Y to currentY-1, returns action code -10, and requests sound/event -3. Retail records begin at -600/0, so this exact transition is not initial-state reachable; no claim is made that it is impossible after an indirect runtime mutation.
kind_0x31.bounded_name: scripted ordinal proximity-emitter family with five metadata variants; route-marker/color presentation is inference, not a promoted visual identity

scope_reconciliation.pass1_props: Passive per-instance baked render payloads. Prior live payload swaps prove render consumption; no prop-local hitbox. Solidity is separately authored collision and belongs to E02.
scope_reconciliation.pass3_decor: Render/cull anchors with a runtime enable bitmap. Static formed-address census across pristine resident code plus all 20 level overlays finds one direct resident bitmap read and zero direct writers. Existing live A/B proves bitmap suppression and level-load reconstruction; indirect pointer writers remain outside what a formed-address census can exclude.
scope_reconciliation.movers_and_switches: Scripted state machines and callbacks are E07 event-VM scope rather than pass-1 prop records.
scope_reconciliation.grain_gates: Threshold and persistence behavior is E09 scope.
scope_reconciliation.dynamic_geometry: Pass-2 registration and moving geometry are E11 scope.
scope_reconciliation.type3f_pickups: Kind-specific collection and persistence are the C-series pickup rows. E08 owns only the placement/runtime classification needed to prevent the catalog from treating them as ordinary props.

persistence_reset.pass1: No independent gameplay persistence state was found or required: source records are render placement/payload inputs rebuilt from DAT on scene load.
persistence_reset.kind31: Authored status is overwritten every frame by visibility; the phase gate is reset by scene initialization; the DAT record is reconstructed on reload. No kind31 field appears in the E14 save schema.
persistence_reset.pass3: The enable bitmap is runtime state reconstructed on level load, not a memcard field. Existing suppression evidence establishes reset behavior without a new replay.
